paragraphs: You can call me an advisor, an executive business coach, a teacher, a guide, or a trainer. None of these titles captures the work completely, as no title captures you fully.

I work with founders and CEOs across Switzerland, the DACH region, and across Europe. For over seven years, I've been alongside people navigating decisions that don't have clean answers — where the strategic question and the personal one turn out to be the same. I'm ICF PCC-certified, with training in many coaching methodologies, leadership coaching, ACT therapy, and contemplative practice.

The work I bring draws from a longer arc. I've run my own businesses, hired, fired, opened, closed. I've worked as a professional dancer and choreographer across Europe, trained in somatic practice, shiatsu, and martial arts, and logged several thousand hours in meditation. I've led retreats, taught on stages and in studios, and coached clients internationally for the past eight years. All of it means that when you're in the room with me, I'm not looking at just one dimension of your challenge and vision. Together we work on the whole person, the whole business, and your whole life.
I live between the Alpstein and the Bodensee with my wife Jae.
